description: Rich Heartbeat Model (PID, Exit Code, Liveness State) and Heartbeat Service: Create HeartbeatRun SQLModel and a service layer for creating/updating/querying heartbeat runs.
steps: 1. Create src/nexus/models/heartbeat_run.py with HeartbeatRun SQLModel table: id (UUID PK), agent_id (UUID FK to agents.id, indexed), session_id_before (str | None), session_id_after (str | None), process_pid (int | None), exit_code (int | None), signal (str | None), stdout_excerpt (str | None, max 2000 chars), stderr_excerpt (str | None, max 2000 chars), liveness_state (str: healthy/suspected_stale/confirmed_dead), continuation_attempt (int default 0), context_snapshot (dict | None, sa_column JSON), invocation_source (str: on_demand/scheduled/trigger/heartbeat), started_at (datetime), finished_at (datetime | None), last_output_at (datetime | None), created_at (datetime).

2. Create src/nexus/runtime/heartbeat_service.py with HeartbeatService class: __init__(). Methods: create_run(agent_id, process_pid, invocation_source, session_id_before, context_snapshot) -> HeartbeatRun, update_liveness(run_id, liveness_state) -> HeartbeatRun, record_output(run_id, stdout_excerpt, stderr_excerpt) -> HeartbeatRun, finish_run(run_id, exit_code, signal, session_id_after) -> HeartbeatRun, get_active_runs(agent_id) -> list[HeartbeatRun], get_latest_run(agent_id) -> HeartbeatRun | None, increment_continuation(run_id) -> HeartbeatRun, detect_stale(threshold_seconds: int) -> list[HeartbeatRun]. Use in-memory storage for testability (same pattern as other services).
3. Add LivenessState enum (healthy, suspected_stale, confirmed_dead) and InvocationSource enum (on_demand, scheduled, trigger, heartbeat) in the heartbeat_run.py module.
4. Add HeartbeatRun import to src/nexus/models/__init__.py and to __all__.

6. Create tests/test_heartbeat_service.py with tests: create_run with all fields, update_liveness transitions, record_output truncates at 2000 chars, finish_run sets exit_code and finished_at, get_active_runs filters by agent, get_latest_run returns most recent, increment_continuation increases count, detect_stale finds runs without recent output, full lifecycle (create -> output -> finish).
acceptance_criteria: HeartbeatRun SQLModel has all required fields (process_pid, exit_code, signal, stdout/stderr_excerpt, liveness_state, continuation_attempt, context_snapshot, session_id_before/after, invocation_source, timestamps)
HeartbeatService can create, update, and query heartbeat runs
